about_the_game:
YOUR MECHA, YOUR STRATEGY, YOUR VICTORY

ACE Strategy: Mecha Nova is the ultimate mecha deck building game where you pilot powerful war machines, build strategic decks, and battle across procedurally generated campaign. Choose your faction, recruit allies, and prove your tactical superiority in this roguelike campaign.

GAME RULES

  • Pilot your chosen mech through randomized levels, collecting powerful gear and elite pilots.

  • Command a battlefield of up to 9 units (ACE Mechas, Ally Mechas, and Drones) on a 3x3 grid.

  • Destroy the enemy's Mecha to claim victory and advance through the campaign.

KEY FEATURES

  • DIVERSE MECHA ARSENAL - Each mecha features exclusive forms and thematic styles. Choose your perfect war machine and form an unbreakable bond.

  • MECHA ALLY - Deploy ally mechas as powerful as your main mech, each with unique skills that can turn certain defeat into glorious victory.

  • DRONE OVERLAY- Overlay identical drones in the same grid position to save space and multiply firepower. Discover special abilities that only unlock with proper overlaying!

  • STRATEGIC POSITIONING - Certain drones boost adjacent other units in specific directions. Master unit placement to create devastating combos where 1+1>2.

  • TACTICAL DECK BUILDING - Utilize chip cards that permanently enhance your mech, plus consumable battle item cards for immediate battlefield impact.

  • PROGRESSIVE UPGRADES - Collect powerful items and chips throughout your campaign. Each choice shapes your strategy and defines your combat style.

IN DEVELOPMENT

  • This version is actively being developed with regular updates based on player feedback.

  • PVP mode is also now available in beta! The roguelike campaign is just the beginning of your journey.

Your mech is the carrier of strength. Your cards are the reach of that strength. Build your strategy and fight for victory!

Talk to us on Discord | Follow us on X
